name: Analyze Ciliary Beat Frequency
description: Analyze ciliary beat frequency from high-speed video microscopy data using FFT analysis.
detailed_description: Analyze ciliary beat frequency from high-speed video microscopy data using FFT analysis.
when_to_use: When you need analyze ciliary beat frequency analysis

parameters.video_path: [Required] Path to the high-speed video microscopy file of ciliary beating (str)
parameters.roi_count: [Optional] Number of regions of interest to analyze (default: 5)
parameters.min_freq: [Optional] Minimum frequency to consider in Hz (default: 0)
parameters.max_freq: [Optional] Maximum frequency to consider in Hz (default: 30)
